text: Teaching Objectives This master program is targeted to train the master candidates in a variety of economic studies in economic development, industrial organization, international trade, investment, financial innovation, resources and environmental economics, and financial management. The teaching staff are composed of professors possessing an oversea backgrounds in Euramerican top universities such as Yale or Oxford and an rich experience in teaching and supervising international students. The Nobel Prize Winners, Professor Robert A. Mundell and Professor Clivew.J.Granger, were invited to give lectures at school. Durations Fall Semester: the end of August to the middle of December Spring Semester: the end of January to the end of May Summer Term: the beginning of June to the end of July Main Courses Internship The university has special apartment to help international student find internship chances in good companies and organizations. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Economics Future Career The university will help get employ chances in good companies and organizations. Research Orientation Industrial organization and competition, Regional economic development strategy and programming, International investment and Multinational business management, Financial innovation and financial engineering, Resources and environmental economic analysis. Note: Masters' Degree Programs for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program.
